name: exercise ball seated triceps stretch
description: A seated overhead stretch for the back of the upper arm, done on a stability ball. Helps loosen tight triceps and shoulders.
instructions: Sit upright on a stability ball with feet planted and apart for balance.
Raise one arm overhead, then bend the elbow so the hand reaches toward your upper back.
Use the other hand to guide the elbow gently inward until you feel a comfortable stretch along the back of the upper arm.
Hold for 15-30 seconds, then switch arms.
